# Motion Mania

> Motion Mania is a desktop app for macOS and Windows that edits broadcasts you own or have permission to use into vertical 1080×1920 clips with captions and sound. Detection, editing and rendering run on your own computer.

- Free plan: editing, Manual Edit (cuts, captions, text, stickers, music, 13 sound effects), merge clips, post manually.
- Pro: $14.99/month. Adds Pro Edit, up to 3 live streams at once, the phone app, Storyline (AI story arcs), AI titles and the AI quality check, and auto-upload to YouTube Shorts and TikTok (coming soon).
- Support: support@motionmania.app

## Product

- [Features](https://motionmania.app/features): real-time detection, vertical layouts, word-level captions, Manual Edit, Pro Edit, Storyline, clip merging, music, 13 sound effects, phone approval and auto-upload
- [Pricing](https://motionmania.app/pricing): Free and Pro monthly
- [Download](https://motionmania.app/download): installers, requirements and first-run steps
- [Free clipping tool](https://motionmania.app/free-clipping-tool): what the free plan does, no watermark or credits
- [GTA 6 clipping tool](https://motionmania.app/gta6-clipping-tool): clip GTA 6 streams and VODs into vertical clips
